scenes.headline: How earshot turns a sound file into Python
scenes.sub: Analysis by synthesis: three fitters, one score, no neural network
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pintle! Earshot fit takes a recording and writes a Python recipe that makes the sound again. Here is how it works, with no neural network inside.

scenes.text: Fit small synthesis models whose parameters a sound designer would name, render every one, and keep the one that sounds closest.
scenes.say: Fit small synthesis models with parameters a sound designer would name. Render every one. Keep the one that sounds closest.

scenes.title: From a recording to a recipe

steps.say: First it measures the sound. Attack, decay, how tonal it is, whether the pitch glides. That names a class and orders the candidates.
Then three classic fitters run. Damped modes for struck things, tracked partials for tones, and a banded noise gesture for whooshes. Hybrids stack them.
Each candidate is rendered and scored against the recording.
The lowest score is written out as a recipe module.

scenes.title: The score that picks the model

parts.say: Mel is the spectrogram distance in decibels.
Tone is the balance across third-octave bands, weighted lightly.
And r is how well the loudness contours line up. Onset and leftover energy terms follow.

scenes.title: What the recipe holds
scenes.say: The file it writes is mostly data.

items.say: A model literal, with each partial as a few frequency and level breakpoints, plus noise bands.
Defaults that re-render the fit exactly.
And knobs, like transpose, decay and brightness, to make new takes.
Render hands it all to the earshot engine, so it needs earshot installed.

scenes.title: Target vs the fitted render
scenes.note: our log-mel L1, lower is closer
scenes.say: On a shared CPU, a synthetic struck bar came back almost exactly, and its three modes were found. The pitch glide was the weakest fit.

scenes.text: The code is a readable parameter set with knobs. The knobs, not the bytes, are the point.
scenes.say: The code is a readable parameter set with knobs. The knobs, not the bytes, are the point.

recap: Measure, fit three models, render each
A hand-weighted score keeps the closest
The recipe is data plus knobs
scenes.say: Measure, fit, render, score. What you get back is a sound you can turn.
